mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 MoM and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase MoM and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in a tightening cycle and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
